title: PAH-OMC-026 cut-set to owner-packet sufficiency crosswalk
question: Does a complete R-557 ten-field source-owner packet, together with the registered full-domain J/D estimates, instantiate every R-565 cut while preserving the exact PAH-001 model and j-before-anchored-n order?
method: Hash-pin PAH-001, R-557, R-565 and the PAH-OMC-026 contract.
Partition the ten R-557 fields into S0 source semantics, S1 complete comparison, S2 temporal control and cross-cut verification.
Prove that a complete packet implies the coarse cuts, while a coarse-cut-only witness without verification is not a complete packet.
Combine the unchanged nonnegative J+D error budget with fixed-n J-zero and anchored-n D-zero in the nested ordered-error theorem.
Run primary, independent, hostile, integrated and Lean checks without adding a carrier, changing PAH-001 or importing a physical interpretation.
finding: The R-557 ten-field packet is a strict refinement of the R-565 coarse cut-set: authority/root semantics fill S0, common realization and N1/N2b/N2c-N4/N2d fill S1, full-domain J and anchored D fill S2, and verification is cross-cut. A complete packet plus the model-specific J/D estimates implies the registered nested ordered-error conclusion conditionally; the coarse cuts alone do not admit a packet. No source-authorized packet or PAH-specific J/D estimates are present, so R-566 and PAH-OMC-020 remain HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
decision_reason: This is a reusable logical crosswalk that closes the ambiguity between the minimal route frontier and the field-level owner contract. It advances the re-entry specification without repeating owner searches, finite carriers, radial diagnostics or abstract persistence oracles.
boundary: PAH-001 functional, rates, state, carrier, external stochastic Markov time, R-512 target and j-before-anchored-n order remain unchanged. The crosswalk is conditional and does not construct any missing source object or analytic estimate.
verification_summary: Primary 21/21, independent 15/15, hostile 8/8, integrated 17/17 and Lean PASS under Lean 4.32.1 with fourteen finite declarations.

reproduction.lean: Set-Location verification/lean; lake env lean Tect/PahOmc026CutSetPacketCrosswalk.lean

next_action: Obtain one source-authorized, hash-pinned packet filling all ten R-557 fields and the model-specific J/D estimates without changing PAH-001 or its j-before-anchored-n order; then run the unchanged admission predicate once.
revisit_condition: Reopen only when that packet is present or an exact unchanged-source contradiction to the crosswalk is found; do not repeat finite, radial or abstract diagnostics.
non_claims: This is a conditional logical crosswalk, not PAH-OMC-020 convergence or a universal no-go for owner-fixed successors.
No common Hilbert space, U_n, path law, N2b/N2c/N4 estimate, compensator, generator, carrier, rate, state, regulator or limit is constructed.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE conclusion; external Markov time remains stochastic bookkeeping.
